notes: DSpark weights loaded in all runs; output_token_least=1 disables speculation for control requests; greedy; prefix/history cache disabled.
Expert cache uses default direct SSD I/O; Engram uses buffered disk reads.
Two warmups, then off/on and on/off measured pairs in one process. Draft/target experts share the same 64 GiB cache.
All 192 output tokens must match the fully disabled reference; installed library is unchanged from the normal DSpark retest.
CUDA is synchronized at operator boundaries, and CUDA Graph is disabled. These timings are separate from normal unsynchronized throughput.
Operator records distinguish target plain/verify, draft, commit and prefill. Nested operator exclusive timings avoid double counting.
pread timing includes overlapping asynchronous expert prefetch and must not be added to compute timing.
All comparison rows exclude prefill and draft initialization included in TTFT.
Speed ratios greater than 1 indicate acceleration; less than 1 indicate slowdown.
Mean target-forward costs are cumulative across all 40 model layers.
Ideal batching divides by all verifier input rows; committed-token batching divides by accepted drafts plus one anchor.
Net per-output-token costs include all target forwards, drafts and commits, normalized by actual fetched output tokens excluding the first.
Detailed CPU linear times are contained in MergeMOE; pread durations can overlap CPU computation and are not additive.
Operator exclusive timing avoids counting nested wrappers twice. Synchronization can alter GPU performance; use normal uninstrumented runs for deployment throughput.
CpuLinear/w2 combines routed Q4_K and shared FP16 down projections; these cannot be separated by the existing weight-name detail label.
CPU Linear detail timers include input quantization and matrix computation and are already included in MergeMOE.
Window-store work deferred by verification is measured in commit; a zero verifier WindowStore cost is not an eliminated operation.
The mean cost is over two measured requests per mode with alternating off/on and on/off order, 382 plain target forwards and 102 verifier forwards.
